audited_at: 2026-09-04 (Directive 04, after environment network policy changed to Full access)
summary: Environment network access was opened mid-session. cyberjapandata.gsi.go.jp, maps.gsi.go.jp, and nlftp.mlit.go.jp (MLIT KSJ) became reachable; fgd.gsi.go.jp and mapps.gsi.go.jp did not (502, repeated). Real data was acquired for the station point, the railway alignment near the station (both bracketed 2008/2011, confidence A), terrain (GSI DEM10B, confidence B), roads (MLIT KSJ N13, current-only, confidence B), and one facility (緑の湯, confidence B via a documented 1999 opening date). Buildings and 4 of 5 remaining named facilities are still unknown/synthetic — no fabricated data was introduced anywhere.

confirmed: LOC_MIDORI_STATION (position, confidence A — MLIT KSJ N02, byte-identical across 2008 and 2011 editions bracketing 2010-05-30)
unknown: exact platform/building layout, any 2010-specific detail beyond the station's confirmed position

confirmed: RAIL_SENMO_KSJ_000/001/002 (釧網線 near the station, confidence A — same MLIT KSJ bracket as the station)
unknown: exact alignment beyond the clipped ~2.5km radius around the station (not fetched — full extent to World bounds would need a wider clip of the same source, which is straightforward to extend later)

reconstructed: 102 ROAD_KSJ_N13_* features (confidence B, historical_status 'current-only') — real MLIT KSJ N13 2024-edition road centerlines; existence_in_2010 explicitly marked 'unknown' per feature, since no 2010-adjacent N13 vintage exists
unknown: whether each specific road existed in its current form in 2010 — geometry is real and current, historical existence is not confirmed
all building footprints and existence — BLDG_SYNTH_* remain Directive 01 SYNTHETIC placeholders; fgd.gsi.go.jp (基盤地図情報 建築物の外周線) remained unreachable even under Full network access

reconstructed: real GSI DEM10B elevation grid (confidence B, historical_status 'plausible'), 99.5m-298.3m across ~2.5km of the World origin — replaces the Directive 01 flat ~130m synthetic guess
unknown: exact terrain-survey date for this specific area (GSI's page gives only a 2013-10-30 tile-SERVICE start date, not a per-region survey date); no LiDAR-grade DEM5A/5B/5C/1A coverage exists here at all (all 404)

reconstructed: FACILITY_MIDORINOYU (緑の湯) — confidence B for existence-by-2010 (town's own page: opened 1999); geometry_confidence C, position is a walking-distance estimate only, no published coordinate
緑駅前広場 (LOC_MIDORI_STATION_PLAZA) — confidence C, structural inference only, unchanged from Directive 02
unknown: 緑町小学校 — no coordinate available, not registered as Reality Data
緑センター — no coordinate available, not registered as Reality Data
緑郵便局 — no coordinate available, not registered as Reality Data
緑スキー場 — no coordinate available, not registered as Reality Data

reconstructed: EVENT_MIDORI_FESTIVAL_20100530 (confidence B) — the event series itself is independently confirmed as real and 21 years old by 2010 (清里町の歴史: 平成元年/1989 first held); the specific 2010-05-30 date and that year's program (クマゲラ太鼓/丸太転がし選手権/みどりのウォーキング) still trace only to the operator's own assertion
unknown: start time, attendance, exact plaza layout during the 2010 event; whether 2010's program matched the elements named in the directive

headline_gaps: Buildings: still zero real data. fgd.gsi.go.jp (基盤地図情報, which would carry 建築物の外周線) remained unreachable (502) even under Full network access, unlike every other GSI/MLIT host tried.

mapps.gsi.go.jp (the GSI aerial-photo viewer UI) also remained unreachable (502); no documented lat/lon+year query endpoint for it was found either. Genuine imagery WAS obtained via the directly-queryable seamlessphoto XYZ tile endpoint instead, but it is an undated current composite (proven non-2010 by visible post-2012 solar panel arrays) and could not serve as 2010 evidence.

No year-specific 2007-2012 aerial photo tiles (nendophoto{year}) exist for this rural location at all — confirmed via direct 404s (not a tile-math bug, cross-checked against GSI's own reference tile and neighboring tiles).
4 of 6 named §20 facilities (緑町小学校, 緑センター, 緑郵便局, 緑スキー場) still have no Reality Data entry — no coordinates were fabricated for them.
Road data has no 2010-adjacent MLIT vintage at all (N13 jumps from 2024 straight to 2026 on the live site) — unlike railway data (N02), which does have a usable 2008/2011 bracket.
